summary: A missing hiker was reported in the Geneva Lake area after his partner feared he had fallen and become injured or deceased; Pitkin County Search and Rescue and West Elk Search and Rescue were deployed along with a helicopter out of Glenwood Springs; after several hours it was discovered he had made it to his destination unharmed.
responding_agency: Pitkin County Search and Rescue; West Elk Search and Rescue
notes: Per-incident one-liner from the Gunnison County Sheriff's Office weekly press release (July 9, 2018 edition). Mined run 463.
